published.source: Client 70425 racials and the raid damage hits, re-measured on master 4f5c608, 2026-10-16

verify.note: same sim as the published number

rotation: Start in Berserker Stance with no Rage; Battle Shout from the raid
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
Death Wish held for the last 36s, Recklessness for the last 30s
Blood Fury and Berserking held for the last 30s, Elune's Light with Death Wish; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20s
Execute first in the execute phase
Bloodthirst, then Slam from 30 Rage right after a main hand swing, then Whirlwind at 25+ Rage
Heroic Strike queued from 85 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: The on-use trinket's last use is held for the final 34s.
White hit Rage scales with weapon speed (measured at level 30, assumed ×1.5 at 60).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit. Each crit restarts the tick timer (our choice).
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike counts for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 12.0.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece not counted. It would add 8.8 vs Humanoids.
Holding Death Wish for 36s: +3.5 at 180s, -4 at 120s.
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, about 15 Rage each) are an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_fury_2h -talents 30305013032-25053000152110501 -race Orc -duration 180, unedited (mksettings sets the raid hits, 2 a minute at 1500). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts. Uses the Fury class options (Berserker Stance) as the preset build does; the preset's DefaultConsumes keep an off-hand stone, which has no effect without an off hand.
